# Simulation

## Simulation configuration

::: {.columns .config-slide .simulation-config-slide}
::: {.column width="52%"}

#### Configuration files

::: {.config-path}

```text
config/
  simulation.yaml
  wgs84_anchor.yaml
  robot/
    base.yaml
    devices/
      *.yaml
```

:::

```yaml
simulators:
  gazebo_classic:
    world_package: romea_simulation_gazebo_worlds
    world_name: friction_cone.world
  gazebo:
    world_package: romea_simulation_gazebo_worlds
    world_name: gz_empty.sdf

entities:
  - name: adap2e
    initial_x: 0.0
    initial_y: 0.0
    initial_z: 0.0
    initial_roll: 0.0
    initial_pitch: 0.0
    initial_yaw: 90.0
```

:::

::: {.column width="48%"}

#### Key fields

::: {.config-table}

| Section | Field | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `simulators` | backend name | Selects a simulator |
|  | `world_package` | ROS package containing the world |
|  | `world_name` | World file to load |
| `entities` | `name` | Matches the robot namespace |
|  | initial pose | Spawn position and orientation |

:::

#### Simulation modes

::: {.config-table}

| Mode | Backend |
| --- | --- |
| `simulation` | Auto-selects an installed Gazebo |
| `simulation_gazebo_classic` | Gazebo Classic |
| `simulation_gazebo` | Gazebo Sim / `gz` |
| `simulation_isaac` | Reserved for Isaac Sim |

:::

The WGS84 anchor provides the geographic reference when supported by the
selected backend. Missing entity pose fields default to `0.0`.

:::
:::

## Simulation launch flow

::: {.simulation-dual-flow}
::: {.simulation-flow-section}

### Simulator launch flow
::: {.simulation-flow-figure}
![](img/08_simulation/simulator_launch_flow.svg){.simulation-dual-flow-diagram}
:::

::: {.simulation-flow-explanation}
`tirrex_core/simulator.launch.py` derives the backend from `mode`, resolves
`simulation.yaml` and `wgs84_anchor.yaml`, then delegates world startup to
`romea_simulation_meta_bringup`. The backend launch loads the selected world
from its ROS package or simulator resource path.
:::
:::

::: {.simulation-flow-section}

### Entity spawn flow
::: {.simulation-flow-figure}
![](img/08_simulation/entity_spawn_flow.svg){.simulation-dual-flow-diagram}
:::

::: {.simulation-flow-explanation}
`robot/robot.launch.py` generates the robot meta-description and forwards the
entity type, simulator backend and namespace to ROMEA. The simulation
meta-bringup generates the simulation URDF, applies the pose from
`simulation.yaml`, and invokes the backend-specific spawn launch file.
:::
:::
:::
